subject: docs/coop/artifacts/route-b.DR-004.preview-disposition.v1.json
protocol: independent review of a D-048 Route B preview disposition draft; refute not confirm; this is not owner recording
summary: Every named attack fails and the §3.1 accounting is structurally exact: the seven items this disposition says must not be pretended settled are precisely the seven section31 v4 marks UNBOUND, and the one item it permits preview use of is precisely v4's single BOUND row, with textVerbatim, supplier selector and supplier digest all matching v4's bytes. The rowQuoted cells reproduce live file 08 exactly. The disposition refuses promotion of the instrument in three separate places and forecloses my own ACCEPT being read as owner recording. One advisory: three of the seven UNBOUND items are quoted non-verbatim against freeze §3.1 -- two drop words and S31-8 adds 'of the packet', narrowing a mandatory item's text in a document intended for owner recording. Notably this draft states the DR-124 state-class bound correctly at P-004-3, where its DR-002 sibling does not.

advisoriesList.location: whatMustNotBePretendedSettled, entries for S31-5, S31-7 and S31-8
advisoriesList.observation: The list maps its entries to §3.1 items by S31 id, but three of the seven are not the verbatim item texts. Measured against section31 v4's textVerbatim values, which its checker enforces byte-exactly: S31-5 is cited as 'typed degradation/unavailability after expiry or purge' where the item reads 'typed degradation/unavailability BEHAVIOR after expiry or purge'; S31-7 is cited as 'EVIDENCE, TM, OPERABILITY G19, VERSIONING, and claim-register reconciliation' where the item reads 'THE RESULTING EVIDENCE, TM, …'; and S31-8 is cited as 'independent review plus a retained checker/mutation suite OF THE PACKET' where the item reads 'independent review plus a retained checker/mutation suite', unqualified.
advisoriesList.whyS31EightIsTheOneThatMatters: The other two drop words and preserve meaning. S31-8 adds words and narrows scope. Freeze §3.1 item 8 requires independent review plus a retained checker and mutation suite without qualifying what they cover; rendering it 'of the packet' scopes a mandatory freeze item to one artifact. In a document meant to be owner-recorded, a narrowed rendering of a §3.1 item is the version a later reader may rely on.
advisoriesList.whyItIsNotABlocker: No item is omitted -- all seven UNBOUND items are listed, and they are exactly the seven v4 marks UNBOUND. Nothing is asserted as settled that is not. The surrounding fields keep the full obligation intact: whatRemainsOwedOnRouteA names 'The exact eight-bullet packet inserted through the V1 process with retained proof, custody, joins, and status update', which is file 08's own acceptanceEvidence cell quoted faithfully, so the unnarrowed obligation is present elsewhere in the same document.
advisoriesList.remedy: Quote the three items verbatim from freeze §3.1, as section31 v4 does. If the intent at S31-8 is to say the packet's own review and suite are what DR-004 owes, say that as a separate sentence rather than inside the quoted item text.
advisoriesList.howIFoundIt: By comparing each cited string against section31 v4's textVerbatim values programmatically rather than reading the list for plausibility. The four that match, match exactly, which is what made the three that differ visible.

whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: 36ad7df03c3019ce06daf75d800082fba566510afa1cd19def3d2e987869c61f both times, matching the dispatch. No drift.

The header shape is correct for a draft that binds nothing: documentClass ROUTE-B-DISPOSITION-CANDIDATE, status CANDIDATE-NOT-RECORDED, reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, sealRecommendation DO-NOT-SEAL, binds NOTHING.

The attack 'treats section31 v4 as the Phase-1A packet' fails in three separate places. section31InstrumentIsNotThePacket states 'Accepted Lane R instrument (D-045). Bound=1 unbound=7. isThePhase1AInsertion=false. This disposition does not promote it to the packet.' whatThisDoesNotDo carries 'Does not treat section31 v4 as the packet.' honesty adds 'D-045 already rejected treating section31 v4 as the insertion.' The pinned digest 97727684af2d812d3a677add9b15287db81d6fe36aeaa96d72d5118890a847f6 is the v4 I reviewed, and bound=1 / unbound=7 / isThePhase1AInsertion=false are its actual field values.

The attack 'pretends any UNBOUND §3.1 item is settled' fails structurally, which I tested rather than read. The seven items listed in whatMustNotBePretendedSettled map to S31-1, S31-2, S31-4, S31-5, S31-6, S31-7 and S31-8 — exactly the seven ids section31 v4 marks UNBOUND, with none omitted and none invented. The quotation fidelity of three of them is the advisory above; their standing as unsettled is correctly stated in every case.

theOneBoundItemPreviewMayUse is exact against v4's bytes on all three checkable fields. textVerbatim matches v4's S31-3 item text; the supplier resolves to product-dispositions.v1.json#$.decisions.CD-RT-5.defaultPosture, matching v4's path and selector; and supplierSha256 bbe24527f732f9c265f9cf71b988303a326e45fec0c6adb0d934536d515d6017 matches v4's pinned supplier digest and the live file. Its bound is correctly limited: 'Preview may not treat that default as the eight-bullet packet or as implicit Phase-1A.'

rowQuoted reproduces live file 08's DR-004 row cell for cell: decision 'Mandatory Phase-1A proof/custody insertion is absent'; acceptanceEvidence 'Exact packet inserted through the V1 process with retained proof, custody, joins, and status update'; statusAtAuthoring 'HARD-BLOCKED'; blueprintImpact 'Blocks EVIDENCE, TM, G19, authoritative analysis blueprint'. I extracted each cell independently.

The attack 'coordinator becomes recording authority' fails. ownerWhoMustRecord names 'Evidence/retention authority (file 08 DR-004)' and states 'Coordinator may draft. D-000 does not make the coordinator the Evidence/retention authority.' authorityClaim adds 'is not owner-recorded by existing', and condition1EffectIfOwnerRecorded closes 'This file existing, or an ACCEPT verdict, is not owner recording' — which forecloses this verdict being mistaken for the owner act.

The attack 'silent SATISFIED or condition-1 discharge' fails: 'Does not mark DR-004 SATISFIED', 'Does not insert Phase-1A', and a conditional scope-bounded effect clause, 'May discharge condition 1 for DR-004 within architecture-preview scope only. Conditions 2-5 remain independently required.'
The attack 'authorizes docs/v2/implementation/' fails twice: 'Condition 5 remains the only authorization for docs/v2/implementation/' and 'Does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.'
The attack 'file 08 edited' fails: git reports zero modified tracked files across docs/v2/architecture and docs/coop.

The attack 'cited digests do not match live bytes' fails on all four recordedInputs paths — COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, file 08, section31-supplier-coverage.v4.json and product-dispositions.v1.json all verify. recordedInputs.propertyPins is a prose scope statement rather than a path list, and it correctly names 'freeze §3.1 property pin 19c6a3eb…', which is the segment D-044 wrote and which I reproduced from freeze lines 580-603 at that review.

P-004-3 states the DR-124 state-class bound correctly: 'Rebuildable cache/index or journaled operational metadata.' That names adopted D-002 State's two classes as DR-124 defines them, and is the phrasing I have raised as an advisory against the DR-002 sibling, which drops 'cache/index'. Recorded here as verified-correct so the asymmetry is visible from both files.

whatRemainsOwedOnRouteA is honest about scope beyond this row: it names the eight-bullet packet, the four outstanding section31 v4 advisories S31V4-01 / S31V4-02 / S31V4-CX-A1 / S31V4-CX-A2 which D-045 left owed and which I confirmed at that review, and 'DR-002 AC-4 still names this packet' — correctly linking the two rows without letting either absorb the other.
The honesty field discloses the preference rather than defending it: 'A product owner could keep DR-004 on full Route A; D-048 rejected that for preview scope only.'
reversibility is the correct two-limb form: 'Total before owner recording. After owner recording, overturn also requires that owner's supersession.'
whatIDidNotCheck: The Codex review of this subject. Not read; the file is confirmed absent at review time.
Whether the Evidence/retention authority will record this disposition, and whether it agrees with the scope. Owner recording is the act this draft is not.

Whether P-004-1's permitted preview surface is under-inclusive. I verified it does not exceed the row's blueprintImpact constraint and that its exclusion list covers the unsettled §3.1 subject matter; I did not assess whether more could lawfully be designed.

The merits of CD-RT-5's decided default posture. I verified the disposition quotes it accurately and bounds its use; CD-RT-5 overrides a standing architectural recommendation, which is the product authority's call and predates this act.

Whether freeze §3.1's eight items are individually well-founded. I verified this disposition's rendering of seven of them against section31 v4's pinned textVerbatim values, which are themselves checker-enforced against the freeze.

verdictNote: ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES. The structural accounting is the strongest part and it holds exactly: seven unsettled items matching v4's seven UNBOUND ids, one permitted item matching v4's single BOUND row on all three checkable fields, and three separate refusals to promote the instrument to the packet. The advisory is quotation fidelity — three of seven §3.1 items are rendered non-verbatim, and one of those adds words rather than dropping them, narrowing a mandatory item in a document written to be owner-recorded. It does not admit anything unsettled and the unnarrowed obligation survives elsewhere in the same file, which is why it is an advisory. I found it by comparing strings programmatically rather than reading the list for plausibility; the four exact matches are what made the three deviations visible.
